posting.title: Regional Sales Director, TOK
posting.descriptionPlain:
Who We Are
Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.
We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.
You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.
About the Role
As Verkada continues to expand our enterprise footprint across Japan, we are hiring our first Tokyo-based Regional Sales Director to lead and grow our Enterprise team. This is a unique opportunity to make a significant impact at a fast-growing, disruptive technology company as we scale our presence in one of APAC’s most strategic markets.
Our mission is clear: to protect people and places in a privacy-sensitive way. Verkada’s cloud-based technology is transforming physical security across key Japanese industries, including manufacturing, retail, logistics, commercial real estate, healthcare, and education. In this role, you will be responsible for localised market execution, developing and leading the regional enterprise sales strategy, and driving performance through a team of high-performing Enterprise Account Executives.
This role is based in our Tokyo office, working closely with our local leadership, sales engineering, and channel teams to build a market-leading enterprise organization.
What You’ll Do
Lead and Scale: Lead, mentor, and scale a team of Enterprise Account Executives focused on driving new business across major Japanese enterprise accounts.
Executive Field Presence: Maintain a strong presence in the field, meeting customers and partners, supporting reps on high-value deals, and building deep, trust-based executive relationships (nemawashi and C-suite alignment) with key accounts.
Revenue Ownership: Own team performance against quarterly and annual revenue targets across Japan.
Strategic Deal Execution: Guide Enterprise AEs in building and executing multi-threaded account strategies to uncover, develop, and close complex, multi-site enterprise opportunities.
Channel & SI Ecosystem: Partner closely with Channel Development and major Japanese System Integrators (SIs), telecommunications carriers, and distributors to strengthen Verkada’s two-tier distribution presence and pipeline across Japan.
Forecast & Pipeline Rigor: Drive disciplined pipeline management through weekly one-on-ones, team reviews, and regular forecast sessions aligned with global headquarters.
Hands-on Closing: Actively participate in key deals, leading executive-level conversations, assisting in commercial negotiations, and supporting complex closings.
Culture & Localization: Foster a high-performance culture that bridges Verkada’s fast-paced, global Silicon Valley ethos with Japanese business etiquette, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate closely with local and global Enterprise Development, Sales Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and Enablement teams to optimize regional execution and ensure compliance with Japanese data privacy standards (APPI).
Talent Acquisition: Recruit, onboard, and develop top bilingual enterprise sales talent in partnership with Verkada’s in-house recruiting and enablement teams.
Travel: Regular travel is required, primarily domestic across key hubs (such as Osaka, Nagoya, and Fukuoka) as well as periodic international travel to our US headquarters or APAC regional hubs.
What You Bring
Language Proficiency: Native in Japanese and business-level English to effectively engage local C-level executives and collaborate seamlessly with global leadership.
Enterprise Leadership: 5–10+ years of experience leading a high-performing enterprise IT B2B sales team in a complex technology environment within Japan.
Greenfield & Enterprise Track Record: Proven success driving greenfield growth and closing large, strategic deals with major Japanese enterprises.
Complex Sales Navigation: Strong experience navigating long, consensus-driven, multi-stakeholder sales cycles (including Ringi approval processes), ideally across manufacturing, retail, commercial real estate, or public sector accounts.
Domain Background: Background selling physical security, enterprise SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or IT/network solutions in Japan is highly desirable.
Channel Mastery: Demonstrated ability to work effectively with and through Japanese channel partners, distributors, and large System Integrators.
Sales Methodology: Deep understanding and practical application of MEDDPICC or similar structured enterprise sales methodologies.
Executive Presence: Exceptional communication, cultural fluency, executive presence, and strategic thinking skills.
Player-Coach Mentality: A hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves leadership style comfortable coaching in the field and selling alongside your team.
Growth Mindset: Highly driven, intellectually curious, and thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth multinational environment.
Education: Bachelor’s degree strongly preferred.
Japan Employee Benefits
Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:
Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs
Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits
Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, generous time off, and personal sick time
Professional development stipend
Wellness/fitness benefits
Healthy lunches provided daily
Commuter benefits
Additional Information
You must be independently authorised to work in Japan. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role, at this time.
Verkada Is An Equal Opportunity Employer
As an equal opportunity employer, Verkada is committed to providing employment opportunities to all individuals. All applicants for positions at Verkada will be treated without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.
Your application will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.
